source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When this model's unit finishes shooting in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), if no enemy unit is within [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of it, that unit may make a Normal move (6" at most) as though in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase). Doing so stops it from declaring a charge for the rest of the turn.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
